newsitem.title: CANADA: Cadillac Fairview buys mall stakes from T. Eaton.
newsitem.headline: Cadillac Fairview buys mall stakes from T. Eaton.

text.p: Canadian property developer Cadillac Fairview said on Tuesday that it has increased its ownership in four Canadian regional shopping centers in a series of transactions worth C$200 million.
Cadillace Fairview said in a statement that it acquired T. Eaton Co Ltd 's interests in two shopping malls in British Columbia and in two properties in Quebec.

Cadillac Fairview and its co-owner, Toronto-Dominion Bank, each acquired 50 percent of Eaton's one-third interest in Vancouver's Pacific Centre. Cadillac and the bank now own 50-percent each of the shopping complex.
Cadillac Fairview also picked up Eaton's 50-percent interest in Victoria Eaton Centre, located in Victoria, British Columbia.
The Toronto-based company said it and co-owner Ivanhoe III Inc also acquired Eaton's 24.5 percent stakes in Montreal's Le Carrefour Laval and Les Promenades St-Bruno shopping centers.
Cadillac Fairview now holds a 67.5 percent interest in these two properties. Ivanoe has the remaining 43.25 percent stake in these centers.
